baseline: Packaged-image serving, TP8/EP8 flashinfer_mxfp4, DSpark block 3, PHB, NCCL tuner default; 3-round medians, 768-token greedy, cache flushed per cell.

evidence: srt/arg_groups/deepseek_v4_hook.py:273-289 raises ValueError: DeepSeek-V4.1 does not support two-batch overlap yet
srt/batch_overlap/operations_strategy.py:171-183 TBO is prefill(EXTEND)-only; decode raises NotImplementedError
two_batch_overlap.note: Even absent the gate, TBO could not address the C32 decode AllReduce share; decode TBO is unimplemented upstream at this commit.

single_batch_overlap.verdict: SKIPPED (no expected gain, correctness-sensitive untested path)
evidence: SBO combine/down-GEMM overlap activates only for flashinfer_cutedsl or non-Blackwell deep_gemm runners, not flashinfer_mxfp4
On Blackwell (SM120) the fallback path forces fuse_shared_experts_inside_sbo=True, rerouting shared experts through dispatcher hooks untested with Mxfp4FlashinferCutlassMoEMethod + a2a=none

dp_attention.verdict: RAN; rejected for this mixed-load deployment

tp8_baseline.note: identical (replicated) on all 8 ranks; unique node capacity 6.87M tokens

dp_attention.note: per-rank shard; aggregate unique ~16.6M tokens (2.4x), max single request ~2.08M tokens; per-rank budget drops from replicated attention/dense weights and DP graph reserves

dp_attention.quality_smoke: 17*23 -> 391 (greedy); all bench requests returned exactly 768 tokens
dp_attention.conclusion: DP attention trades light-load speed for saturation and KV capacity: C1 -68%, C4 -52%, C16 -9%, C32 +16%, 32k TTFT 5.3->8.0s. A single request runs attention on one GPU. Kept TP8 attention.

decision: Deployment and kit stay on TP8 attention + NCCL tuner default. DP attention documented as a capacity-oriented alternative for saturated-batch or KV-heavy serving.
